description: Banks specialist (US money-centres + ASX big four).
playbook: Cut losers fast: the stop is set before entry, never widened, and is hit by code not by judgement.
Press winners: only add after the trade is in profit and the stop is moved to break-even.
Size up only on A+ setups (trend + catalyst + clean chart + room to target). B setups are a pass.
Stand aside when it is choppy: if price is going sideways with no direction, do nothing.
Never chase a pump: if it has already run hard in days, the easy money is gone.
Know where you are wrong before you know where you are right: invalidation is a price, not a feeling.
Trade with the bigger trend; fight it only with a dated catalyst.
Liquidity first: if you could not get out in a hurry, do not get in.
Scaled half-bank A/A+ only: open net A$ >= entry risk A$ OR +1% vs deploy_basis (first wins) -> bank half, residual stop to BE, then trail. Full flat by +5%. B/C keep prior T1/+2R rails.

FINAL RAILS (Brett HARD via TFO 2026-10-29 17:20 WITA; code-enforced in book.py every tick): HALF-BANK grade A/A+ only (persisted grade field; missing grade = not eligible) when open NET A$ after costs >= 1R of the ORIGINAL entry risk (from the initial stop); Dex/trend seat at 1.5R. No +1% deploy_basis leg. Residual stop -> fee floor (entry + round-trip fees), then ATR/structure trail. GIVEBACK PROTECTION IS DNA (all grades, open-profit trades only, never on flat/losing): around news/volume bank early on a real turn; never sit through a reverse that gives back open profit. Code banks half + residual to fee floor when ANY: (a) peak open net >= 0.5R and >= 50% given back [rail_giveback_protect]; (b) a bar closes through the prior bar's low (long)/high (short) or a recorded pre_event_level on >= 2x 20-bar avg volume [rail_giveback_volturn]; (c) a news item is logged for the position (news_alerts.jsonl / position news_logged_utc) [rail_giveback_news]. Every early bank is audited with a rail counterfactual in state/veteran_desk/early_bank_audit.jsonl. +5% full flat and hard stops unchanged.

TIME STOP (Brett 'Yes go ahead', 17:44 WITA 29 Oct 2026): exit if the trade has not reached +0.5R (net A$ after costs vs ORIGINAL entry risk, peak since entry) by bar N from entry; N for this seat = 7 daily bars. N fixed at entry, never extended; missing mark/failed bar fetch = hold; exit_reason rail_time_stop. Halfway stop at +0.5R REJECTED. PAPER.
